title: SonarQube Cloud reports inconsistent Apache candidate return shapes
title_de: SonarQube Cloud meldet inkonsistente Rückgabeformen der Apache-Kandidaten
summary: Historical SonarQube Cloud PR analysis for PR #56 reported one task-owned python:S8495 code smell at apache_development_candidates(). PR #56 merged to master as a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f; the current function retains one canonical candidate return, the specified regression and legitimate-control tests pass, and current Sonar issue queries show no unresolved original or rule issue.
summary_de: Die historische SonarQube-Cloud-PR-Analyse für PR #56 meldete einen task-eigenen python:S8495-Code-Smell in apache_development_candidates(). PR #56 wurde als a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f nach master gemergt; die aktuelle Funktion behält einen kanonischen Candidate-Return, die spezifizierten Regressions- und legitimen Control-Tests bestehen und aktuelle Sonar-Issue-Abfragen zeigen kein ungelöstes Original- oder Rule-Issue.
observed_behavior: At PR #56 head 63f4c9694f3f1c1372ce6db86ea1f88a38f01a92, ci/tools/run-check-status.py:222-234 returns (value,), tuple(shlex.split(...)), (), or ("apxs", "apxs2") depending on parent-controlled environment selection. SonarQube Cloud issue AZ90uTmr7VSiD7VvMb8Y is OPEN at line 222 with python:S8495 and HIGH Reliability/Maintainability impacts.
observed_behavior_de: Am PR-56-Head 63f4c9694f3f1c1372ce6db86ea1f88a38f01a92 gibt ci/tools/run-check-status.py:222-234 abhängig von der parent-kontrollierten Environment-Auswahl (value,), tuple(shlex.split(...)), () oder ("apxs", "apxs2") zurück. SonarQube-Cloud-Issue AZ90uTmr7VSiD7VvMb8Y ist an Zeile 222 mit python:S8495 sowie HIGH-Auswirkungen auf Reliability und Maintainability OPEN.
expected_behavior: The Parent-owned candidate-selection function preserves its documented precedence while assigning one candidate sequence and returning it through one canonical return path. The current PR-head Sonar issue query must report no open task-owned issue.
expected_behavior_de: Die Parent-eigene Kandidatenauswahlfunktion bewahrt ihre dokumentierte Priorität, weist aber genau eine Kandidatensequenz zu und gibt sie über einen kanonischen Rückgabepfad zurück. Die Sonar-Issue-Abfrage für den aktuellen PR-Head darf kein offenes task-eigenes Issue melden.
impact: The observable behavior is currently covered by focused controls, but the task-owned SonarCloud reliability and maintainability issue blocks the requested verified_pr disposition. No evidence shows a recurrence of the untrusted-child-output bypass fixed by FND-PARENT-0025.
impact_de: Das beobachtbare Verhalten ist aktuell durch fokussierte Kontrollen abgedeckt, aber das task-eigene SonarCloud-Issue zu Reliability und Maintainability blockiert die verlangte verified_pr-Disposition. Es gibt keinen Nachweis für eine Wiederkehr des durch FND-PARENT-0025 behobenen Untrusted-Child-Output-Bypasses.
preconditions: Draft PR #56 is analyzed by SonarQube Cloud at source commit 63f4c9694f3f1c1372ce6db86ea1f88a38f01a92.
The Parent optional Apache development prerequisite preflight calls apache_development_candidates().
reproduction: Query the SonarQube Cloud issues API for project Easton97-Jens_ModSecurity-conector, pullRequest=56, and unresolved issues.
Observe open issue AZ90uTmr7VSiD7VvMb8Y (python:S8495) at ci/tools/run-check-status.py:222.
Inspect apache_development_candidates() and observe early tuple returns with differing cardinalities.
root_cause: The status-channel remediation introduced several semantically valid but structurally divergent tuple return paths. SonarQube Cloud conservatively flags the varying tuple arity as a reliability and maintainability pitfall. No child output is used as control data and no security-bypass recurrence was observed.
root_cause_de: Die Statuskanal-Remediation führte mehrere semantisch valide, aber strukturell divergierende Tuple-Rückgabepfade ein. SonarQube Cloud markiert die unterschiedliche Tuple-Arity konservativ als Reliability- und Maintainability-Fallstrick. Child-Ausgabe wird nicht als Kontrolldatum verwendet und es wurde keine Wiederkehr eines Security-Bypasses beobachtet.
proposed_remediation: Use an explicitly typed local candidate sequence, preserve APXS_BIN → APXS → CI_APXS_BIN_CANDIDATES → default precedence, and return that sequence exactly once. Add an AST regression assertion and a real parent preflight control; do not suppress Sonar, disable the rule, or alter the status-channel trust boundary.
proposed_remediation_de: Eine explizit typisierte lokale Kandidatensequenz verwenden, die Priorität APXS_BIN → APXS → CI_APXS_BIN_CANDIDATES → Default bewahren und diese Sequenz genau einmal zurückgeben. Eine AST-Regressionsassertion und eine echte Parent-Preflight-Kontrolle ergänzen; Sonar nicht unterdrücken, die Rule nicht deaktivieren und die Statuskanal-Trust-Boundary nicht ändern.
acceptance_criteria: apache_development_candidates() has one canonical return of its candidate sequence.
APXS_BIN, APXS, CI_APXS_BIN_CANDIDATES, defaults, and malformed candidate configuration retain their existing semantics.
The focused optional-prerequisite suite covers the single return path and a valid configured APXS preflight control.
The exact #56 PR head has no unresolved task-owned SonarCloud issue; no scanner suppression, rule disablement, or risk acceptance is used.
The status-channel security invariant remains intact: child stdout and stderr cannot authorize an allowed blocked result.
validation_plan: Run tests.test_optional_prerequisite_status before and after the focused correction.
Run the AST single-return regression and the configured absolute APXS legitimate control.
Push only the isolated #56 follow-up, verify local/remote/PR-head equality, and query SonarCloud issue and Quality Gate APIs for the new exact head.
Review the diff for a behavioral change, scanner suppression, or reintroduction of child-output authority.
legitimate_control_tests: A configured absolute APXS candidate succeeds with an empty PATH.
A genuine missing Apache development prerequisite remains a parent-authenticated blocked status.
Malformed CI_APXS_BIN_CANDIDATES remains an empty candidate sequence and does not create a false pass.
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-PARENT-0025. FND-PARENT-0025 concerns authorization of an allowed blocked status from untrusted child output; this finding concerns the static return-shape structure of the subsequently introduced Parent-controlled APXS candidate selector.
residual_risk: No task-owned return-shape or scanner issue remains. The global master Quality Gate error is tracked separately by FND-SONAR-0001 and is not treated as closure evidence for this finding.
residual_risk_de: Kein task-eigenes Return-Shape- oder Scanner-Issue bleibt offen. Das globale Master-Quality-Gate-ERROR wird separat durch FND-SONAR-0001 verfolgt und nicht als Closure-Evidence für dieses Finding behandelt.
final_disposition: closed after https://github.com/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector/pull/56 merged to master as a73c33529f4b900e0e5722f6c8eae2ae47e41c1f; the merge is reachable from origin/master 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c, the two specified controls passed again after test-only PR #229, and current Sonar queries report the original key resolved.

history.detail: Direct SonarQube Cloud PR API evidence confirmed open issue AZ90uTmr7VSiD7VvMb8Y (python:S8495) on the #56 source commit. No suppression or risk acceptance is authorized.

PR #56 is merged and reachable from current origin/master; current canonical-return source inspection, the two specified unittest controls, and Sonar issue readback establish closure without suppression or risk acceptance.

After rebase to current master 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c, the two specified OptionalPrerequisiteStatusTests passed again. PR #229 modified tests only and did not change ci/tools/run-check-status.py or the finding's source scope.
